ValidationRule.description: SS-1410:Account Contact OR Meeting Date can not be null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"Implement"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,"Hold implementation kickoff meeting"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,"Hold first Status Meeting") ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"Onboard"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,"Hold onboarding kickoff meeting"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,"Receive completed pre-implementation requirements checklist") ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"Mature"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,"Deliver Executive Business Review") ) ), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Completed"), OR( ISBLANK(Account_Contact__c), ISBLANK(Meeting_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate the Account Contact and Meeting Date to complete this task
